metadata.architecture: AMG-guided coarse neural weights, full-resolution visible/thermal blending
metadata.objective: Frozen YOLOv8n COCO classification+box+DFL loss on annotated pedestrian GT; 0.1 alpha regularization
metadata.rain: Simulated on visible only; severity train 0.4-0.9, validation/test 0.7
metadata.selection: AP50 validation recommends a checkpoint including epoch zero. The actual comparison evaluates the predeclared last epoch; no test-based model selection.

common_detector_preparation.inputs: Seeded visible / thermal / fixed fusion mix; same 100 annotated training pairs
common_detector_preparation.scope: COCO-pretrained YOLO detection head adapted; backbone and BN buffers fixed. Entire detector frozen for subsequent fusion training.

operating_point.selection: Maximum F1 on validation, original fusion only, shared by all methods

system_before_any_adaptation.definition: Original pretrained AMG-guided fusion plus original COCO YOLO, without the common detector preparation. Same final images, preprocessing and shared threshold.
